description: Search for posts across Reddit or specific subreddits. Returns matching posts with content and metadata. NSFW posts are left out unless include_nsfw is true, and a search inside an NSFW subreddit returns nothing without it.

include_nsfw.description: Leave unset to follow the server setting (NSFW hidden unless the server owner chose otherwise). Set true ONLY IF the user asks for NSFW content; set false to hide it. No effect on a server set to never return NSFW.

limit.description: Default 25, range (1-100). Override ONLY IF user requests.

subreddits.description: Subreddits to search in, max 10 (leave empty for all)

name: search_reddit
